tactics: have key : ∀ a b (t : List.Sublist a b), List.Sublist.below (motive := motive✝) t ∧ motive✝ a b t := by intro a b t; induction t <;> exact ⟨by constructor <;> simp_all, F _ _ _ (by constructor <;> simp_all)⟩

have key : ∀ a b (t : List.Sublist a b), List.Sublist.below (motive := motive✝) t ∧ motive✝ a b t := by intro a b t; induction t with | slnil => exact ⟨.slnil, F _ _ _ .slnil⟩ | cons x h ih => exact ⟨.cons x h ih.1 ih.2, F _ _ _ (.cons x h ih.1 ih.2)⟩ | cons₂ x h ih => exact ⟨.cons₂ x h ih.1 ih.2, F _ _ _ (.cons₂ x h ih.1 ih.2)⟩
have key : ∀ a b (t : List.Sublist a b), List.Sublist.below (motive := motive✝) t ∧ motive✝ a b t := by intro a b t; induction t <;> refine ⟨?_, F _ _ _ ?_⟩ <;> constructor <;> simp_all
